verdict.rationale:
Temporal's CLI includes a documented 'batch' subcommand for tracking bulk job progress (temporal-docs-26), implying support for operations like signal/cancel/terminate across many workflows matching a query, which fits an AI-native bulk-operations need. However, the evidence pack only surfaces one thin reference to batch job progress tracking, without detail on the full scope of supported bulk actions, scale limits, or any hands-on/community confirmation of it working at scale.
missing for 10: full documentation of batch signal/terminate/cancel commands and query syntax, evidence of scale/performance limits, independent or hands-on confirmation of bulk operations succeeding.
